approved_by: researcher (written approval 2026-10-12, before any Stage-B model output)
locked: interpretation_rule + analysis settings (bootstrap resamples/seed/CI level, primary and secondary comparisons)

interpretation_rule.status: FROZEN by researcher decision 2026-10-12 before any Stage-B model output (lock: data/manifests/INTERPRETATION_RULE_FROZEN.json)
interpretation_rule.population: primary Stage-2 set = frozen Stage-1 failures that passed the blinded annotation review
interpretation_rule.delta: Delta_rescue = Rescue(V->L_true) - Rescue(V->V), paired; 95% CI = paired bootstrap percentile interval (analysis.bootstrap_resamples, analysis.bootstrap_seed)
interpretation_rule.STRONG: CI lower bound > 0 AND point estimate >= +0.10
interpretation_rule.diagnostic_content_contrast: V->L_true vs V->L_false is reported as a SEPARATE paired contrast (same statistics); it does not enter the label.
interpretation_rule.not_in_label: False-location gain, truncation/parse robustness and domain subgroups are reported as secondary/sensitivity analyses only.
